title: The flats after the ridge
logline: The first walk after the ridge sequence stopped: the flats, ordinary, gray, the pup and the man from behind, and the ridge behind them at the page's top with nothing over it. The page turns its back on the glow.

panels.composition: Gray mudflats with a man in plaid and an old three-legged dog from behind walking out, and at the page's top behind them a wooded ridge under a plain sky with no glow.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, gray tidal mudflats with a man in plaid flannel and an old three-legged dog seen from behind walking out, a wooded ridge under a plain sky at the top of the page with no glow, no words
